glosses: Treasury (department responsible for management of public revenue)
treasure (any single thing that one values greatly)

examples.text: O tesouro poderia estar em qualquer lugar.
Dizem que há tesouros escondidos lá.
examples.en: It's rumored there are treasures hidden there.
We didn't bury the treasure here.

examples.text: Poucos tesouros são tão valiosos como um amigo.
examples.en: Few treasures are worth as much as a friend.
